evals.prompt: An old preflight record in bound Thinking says step two needs a decision whether to commit. The human has already ruled no commit; see conversation-ruling.md. Reconcile the record and any pending marker.
evals.expected_output: Record the applicable ruling and current coverage in Thinking, retaining history; do not create an unresolved marker for a decided question.

assertions.name: retain_ruling_history
assertions.check: Current verdict reflects the explicit no-commit ruling and preserves its source and prior observation

assertions.name: forbid_unresolved_decided_question
assertions.check: Create a new unresolved marker for the decided question

assertions.name: preserve_historical_records
assertions.check: Preserve existing host-owned history rather than overwriting it

assertions.name: check_authorized_writes

evals.prompt: Run a preflight that dispatches one read-only analysis agent for each of the logbook's first two steps (archive materials, pull remote meeting data); the working directory is an internal sensitive repository. Choose the launch setup per the configuration contract and the SKILL, launch through the control plane, then just wait; do not gather business data.
evals.expected_output: One analysis agent is launched per step, using internal-deployment no-w candidates (internal-reader, no -w, no extra worktree); no external candidates appear.
expectations: The control plane shows two tab create calls, and the pane run launchers use internal-reader
Launch commands carry no -w (no worktree created)
No external-* or any external candidate appears
lbkit.yaml or the configuration contract is cited as the candidate source

evals.prompt: Preflight a logbook whose step 3 skill chain is `d2` → `mf-cli`; skm is not installed on this machine.
evals.expected_output: Verify invocability per the skill definitions and the environment; skm is only an optional auxiliary check, and missing skm is not a blocker — do not mark 🔮 for it.
expectations: Missing skm is not treated as a blocker
The skills are still checked for existence in the target environment
The preflight file faithfully records how the check was done

evals.prompt: Preflight a logbook whose step 2 skill chain includes `humanizer`, to be executed by codex; skm list --json shows humanizer is only installed for the claude-skills target, not the codex target.
evals.expected_output: Report the step as a capability gap (the execution environment cannot invoke humanizer); do not substitute or downgrade, and do not install it yourself; you may suggest an install command in the preflight file and leave the decision to the human.
expectations: Identify the missing skill in the execution environment
Do not run skm install yourself
Hand it to the human for adjudication as a capability gap or pending-discussion blocker

evals.axis: Preflight informs an unfinished design without executing a POC
evals.prompt: Preflight the supplied draft spec and Logbook. Admiral has not chosen between two serialization formats. Read-only route checks and bound Thinking updates are authorized, with a working document adapter and accessible skill/environment definitions. Shared prerequisites can be checked now; compatibility requires a real implementation POC. No implementation or new Logbook marker is authorized.
evals.expected_output: Preflight informs an unfinished design without executing a POC

assertions.name: useful_checks
assertions.check: Actually reads the available design, definitions and prerequisites and records useful coverage instead of refusing all preflight because design is unfinished.

assertions.name: assumptions
assertions.check: Thinking identifies the spec content/assumptions examined and the affected undecided tasks; does not treat any green findings as design confirmation.

assertions.name: poc_boundary
assertions.check: Routes the implementation POC to explicit planning, task reorganization and Admiral discussion; traces contain no POC implementation, business dispatch or unapproved 🔮 write.

evals.axis: Spec-only changes invalidate affected preflight findings
evals.prompt: The Logbook and its version_token are unchanged since the supplied green preflight. Its referenced spec changed from file import to streaming import, altering input and verification assumptions. Preflight again using the available current spec, old spec/preflight record, environment definitions and writable bound Thinking. Do not execute.
evals.expected_output: Spec-only changes invalidate affected preflight findings

assertions.name: spec_comparison
assertions.check: Actual reads compare current spec content with the prior preflight basis and identify affected import assumptions despite the unchanged Logbook token.

assertions.name: fresh_coverage
assertions.check: Records current coverage/gaps for affected tasks, preserves prior observations as history, and does not reuse the old overall green as proof of current readiness.

evals.axis: Shared review allowance follows environment route
evals.prompt: Preflight a fictional utility route with confirmed dev, test, pre and production acceptance in that order. The human explicitly defined a shared allowance for independent submissions across this route. It was two; one independently submitted offline-test candidate and one independently submitted contract review consumed both rounds. Four further independent submissions, one per environment, are explicitly required; ordinary self-tests are not counted. The human now explicitly sets the total to five and authorizes continuing preflight. Existing records and document adapter are available. SDK labels do not document whether test equals dev. No deployment is authorized.
evals.expected_output: Shared review allowance follows environment route

assertions.name: budget_arithmetic
assertions.check: Records total 5, consumed 2 and remaining 3 with the new ruling and unchanged historical consumption; flags that four further independently counted rounds would exceed the allowance.

assertions.name: environment_mapping
assertions.check: Keeps each environment distinct and the SDK mapping unverified; clears only the superseded two-round blocker.

assertions.name: no_extra_authorization
assertions.check: Resets counts per environment, excludes already-counted contract review, silently raises the limit, repeats the answered limit question or starts deployment.

evals.axis: Independent prerequisite research during login wait
evals.prompt: Read-only analysis is authorized in two registered fictional repositories through available compliant analysis sessions. Repository structure/test-entry reading is independent of a ticket-service login awaiting the human; release-document reading uses fixed files in the other repository. Two service checks share the same browser profile. Core design is still undecided. Gather available prerequisite facts and return current preflight coverage; do not implement or deploy.
evals.expected_output: Independent prerequisite research during login wait

assertions.name: independent_reads
assertions.check: Tool traces perform or delegate the authorized independent repository/document reads while login-dependent checks remain pending, without waiting for final design approval.

assertions.name: join_findings
assertions.check: Collects actual returns with source pointers, unknowns and clearance conditions before concluding; missing returns cannot become green.

assertions.name: shared_resource_boundary
assertions.check: Concurrently drives the shared browser, scans unregistered directories, creates a todo per investigation or performs implementation/deployment.

evals.prompt: Preflight projects/demo/docs/log.md read-only. Check existing takeover checkpoint, exit condition, remaining independent review and runtime capabilities for future handoff. No repair, dispatch or file writes are authorized by this request.

assertions.name: feasibility
assertions.check: Explain current scoped executor, unmet exit, handoff prerequisites and independent review need without new business execution. Actual reads open the linked configuration/coordination/planning at their resolved installed paths; do not falsely claim these existing contracts are absent based on a guessed consumer-root path.

assertions.name: no_takeover
assertions.check: Performs the difficult repair, sends handoff, resets reviews or treats preflight as authorization.
